newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH SHIPYARD MARKS CEO'S BIRTHDAY WITH STRIKE.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH SHIPYARD MARKS CEO'S BIRTHDAY WITH STRIKE.

text.p: Workers at Finnish shipbuilder Masa-Yards, part of Norwegian Kvaerner , marked their boss's 60th birthday on Friday with a one-day strike.
All 1,991 blue-collar workers at the yard in the western town of Turku were on strike on Friday, but white-collar staff were at work.

Shop steward Timo Piippo said the strike, protesting at increased use of subcontractors, was arranged before workers knew it fell on CEO Martin Saarikangas' birthday, but had not been cancelled when they found out.
"We will congratulate Saarikangas," Piippo told Reuters: a workers' representative would attend his birthday reception.

Saarikangas is an outspoken and colourful figure widely credited with keeping the yard in business by shifting its output to focus on high-value vessels, like luxury cruise liners, after traditional Russian icebreaker demand collapsed.
